highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.2 corrects filtered image sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
highlights_body: This servicing release brings Skia m156 fixes for image subsets, image-filter caching and glyph masks without changing managed bindings.

bullets.lead: Filtered images stay within their texture subsets
bullets.detail: Corrects sampling under minification, strong skew, antialiased clipping and MSAA so unrelated backing-texture pixels do not leak into filtered images. Image-filter cache-key equality now matches hashing, including distinct floating-point and matrix representations.

bullets.lead: Mask-filtered glyphs handle regenerated data safely
bullets.detail: Uses the reloaded glyph's outline, rejects incompatible mask copies and preserves full plane strides when clipping embossed glyphs. This avoids stale outlines, sub-byte buffer overwrites and corrupted or uncleared mask planes when consecutive glyph loads differ.

v4.156.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.2 corrects filtered image sampling and mask-filtered glyph rendering.
v4.156.2.body: It prevents unrelated backing-texture pixels from entering filtered images, makes image-filter cache equality consistent with hashing, and handles regenerated glyph outlines and mask planes correctly. Managed bindings are unchanged.
